lines: You don't need a single follower to join this. Here's how it pays.
It's Amazon Associates. Share a link to a product, and you earn a cut when someone buys.
Most categories pay around three to four and a half percent. A forty dollar kitchen item at four and a half percent earns you about a dollar eighty.
Great for review, home and tech creators. The catch? You need three sales in your first six months, or the account is closed.
Send this to a creator friend, and follow for one income stream every day.
